flags.why: The creek sense belongs to North Central Vietnamese, not Northern Vietnamese ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/h%C3%B3i)).
Calling someone's background hèn hạ expresses contempt for their social status rather than neutral humble origins ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/hen-ha-eRAQCKR8OcEBe.html)).
The common noun meaning 'title' of a book, song or other work is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-t%E1%BB%B1a)).
flags.fix: Add noun sense: title (of a book, song or other work).

flags.why: The common adjective meaning 'magical; fairy-tale-like' is missing ([Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/th%E1%BA%A7n_ti%C3%AAn)).
Calling someone hâm can mock their intelligence or mental state, so colloquial alone does not supply the needed warning ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/h%C3%A2m,3,0,0.html)).
